baseline_models.reading: ʿĀd and Thamūd are recalled through a condition already apparent to the addressees from their dwellings. The opening leaves the precise event unexpressed.

focus_anchor.quote_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ
focus_anchor.role: Names the peoples and makes their dwellings the source of clarity for the present audience.

activation_trace.role: The proper-name scope identifies ʿĀd without turning the name into a verb of returning.
Becoming apparent supplies the epistemic claim.
The residence scope keeps the evidence grounded in actual habitations.

structural_cues.role: The perfect with قَد presents achieved clarity; لَكُم identifies its recipients and مِن connects it to the dwellings.

baseline_models.mechanism: The opening accusatives invite an understood governing expression, while the following clause directs attention from named peoples to dwelling-based evidence about them.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies the names, dwellings, and achieved clarity. Supplying their condition or fate as the understood matter is syntactic inference; the focus alone does not spell out its exact content.
baseline_models.containment: Do not specify a deleted verb, architectural style, location, or mechanism of destruction from this baseline.

baseline_models.reading: Satan made their own deeds attractive and consequently diverted them from the right way, although they possessed discernment.

focus_anchor.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
focus_anchor.role: Connects attractive evaluation, diversion, and the continuing attribution of discernment.

activation_trace.role: Presenting something as beautiful explains attractiveness without establishing actual goodness.
The object is their intentional conduct, not merely decorative possessions.
Its transitive scope supplies preventing or diverting people from something.
A traversable way extends naturally to a course of conduct.
The inner-sight scope supports genuine discernment or knowledge.

structural_cues.role: فَ connects diversion to beautification; the final positive predicate creates tension rather than explicitly declaring blindness.

baseline_models.mechanism: The manipulation works through the attractiveness of their conduct. Possessing discernment does not itself ensure following the way.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The causal sequence and positive attribution are supplied. Reading the final وَ as concessive and the way as right guidance is the ordinary contextual interpretation; simple coordination remains grammatically possible. The object and extent of their discernment are unstated.
baseline_models.containment: Preserve the ordinary reading without claiming either complete religious knowledge or loss of the faculty of understanding.

baseline_models.reading: Alternatively, their being discerning may be heard through their own confident outlook: Satan made their conduct seem commendable, and they were assured of their course.

focus_anchor.role: The unqualified predicate permits exploration of what, and from whose perspective, they considered clear.

activation_trace.role: The knowledge and assurance scope supplies the cognitive state, not an independently supplied meaning of pretending.
Presented attractiveness supplies a possible object of their confident appraisal.

structural_cues.role: Clarity is attributed to the present addressees.
The contrasting لَهُمُ marks the earlier actors' interested perspective on their own deeds.

baseline_models.mechanism: The contrast between what is clear to you and what looked attractive to them permits an ironic reading of their assurance.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The perspectival contrast is textual. Supplying in their own estimation and directing their assurance toward their deeds are reader assumptions. Genuine insight resisted in practice remains the stronger ordinary alternative.
baseline_models.containment: Do not translate مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ as pretending to see or claim that the text explicitly reports their self-description.

context_deltas.reading: Beautification can operate through a reassuring invitation to another party's path, especially a false promise that following it will carry no personal liability.

focus_anchor.role: Leaves the means by which conduct became attractive open.

activation_trace.role: The shared way-image makes a socially offered course a concrete alternative to the focus's way.
Presentation by speech can make a course attractive without changing its actual consequences.

structural_cues.role: Pairs following our way with a reassuring offer to bear sins.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَمَا هُم بِحَٰمِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَٰيَٰهُم مِّن شَىْءٍ
structural_cues.role: Exposes the assurance as ineffective.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
structural_cues.role: Provides the attractiveness-to-diversion sequence to which this social mechanism returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: An apparently safe path can recruit followers by disguising the consequences of their own action. This supplies an in-window possible vehicle for satanic beautification.

changed_reading.before: The means of making their deeds attractive is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Attractiveness may include persuasive assurances that a competing course is safe because others will assume responsibility.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The invitation and its refutation are supplied. Applying that mechanism to the focus is analogical; the packet does not identify these speakers as the historical tempters of ʿĀd or Thamūd.
context_deltas.containment: Present as a possible social operation of deception, not as a recovered historical episode or an identification of Satan with the speakers.

context_deltas.reading: The dwellings function as material warning signs for later reasoners. Their former inhabitants' discernment also warns the present audience that recognizing evidence is not enough.

focus_anchor.role: Makes a material setting disclose something to the current audience.

activation_trace.role: Leaving an effect behind makes the earlier settlement a continuing evidential resource.
A clear sign supplies the earlier counterpart to the focus's achieved clarity.
The repeated clarity image links habitation evidence to the preceding sign.

structural_cues.quote_ar: سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ
structural_cues.role: Establishes looking in the land as a route to inference, here concerning creation.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
structural_cues.role: Explicitly directs a remaining settlement-related sign toward reasoning.
Transfers the evidential role to these peoples' dwellings and to you.
Prevents the reader from treating perceptiveness alone as protection from their outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The land-observation instruction and the remaining clear sign turn the focus's dwellings into evidence to be interpreted and acted upon, not incidental scenery.

changed_reading.before: Their dwellings make their condition apparent.
changed_reading.after: Their dwellings are an admonitory evidential resource for an audience itself required to use discernment well.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The sign, reasoning, observation, and audience shift are supplied. The warning against merely recognizing evidence is inferred from their juxtaposition. No assumption of a particular journey is needed.
context_deltas.containment: 29:20 concerns creation, not explicitly a visit to these ruins. Do not invent an itinerary or claim that every detail of their history is visually recoverable.

context_deltas.reading: The attractiveness of their deeds may be socially sustained: belonging and mutual affection can make a wrongful collective practice appealing even to discerning people.

focus_anchor.role: The plural beneficiaries and their own deeds permit a collective evaluative setting.

activation_trace.role: Affection and attachment explain a present social attraction attached to idol-taking.
The presentation of attractiveness can include social approval rather than only visual decoration.

structural_cues.quote_ar: أَوْثَٰنًۭا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
structural_cues.role: Connects idol-taking with present mutual affection.

structural_cues.quote_ar: يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍۢ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًۭا
structural_cues.role: The later reversal exposes the limits of that solidarity.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
structural_cues.role: Allows social attraction to explain diversion without first eliminating discernment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present belonging can compete with the direction indicated by knowledge; the eventual collapse of solidarity distinguishes attractive affiliation from reliable guidance.

changed_reading.before: Beautification could be understood primarily as an individual's mistaken appraisal.
changed_reading.after: It may also describe collectively reinforced approval whose emotional rewards outweigh recognized guidance.

context_deltas.reader_inference: 29:25 supplies affection and its reversal. The causal transfer to the focus is reader-supplied; neither this motive nor specific idols are separately assigned to these two peoples here.
context_deltas.containment: Retain as a possible social explanation, distinct from false liability promises and from purely cognitive error.

context_deltas.reading: Diversion is sharpened as blocked passage: seeing a way and actually traversing it are different, so their discernment need not contradict their being prevented from following it.

focus_anchor.role: Places obstruction and discernment next to one another.

activation_trace.role: The road-blocking scope provides a concrete obstruction model.
Transitive prevention makes the people the objects of diversion.
The way-image connects moral direction to traversable passage.

structural_cues.role: Makes the way an object of human obstruction in the preceding narrative.
Reuses the definite way while making people the objects of obstruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated way and changed grammatical roles distinguish knowing or seeing a route from being directed along it.

changed_reading.before: Diversion is a moral outcome expressed through a way metaphor.
changed_reading.after: The preceding road obstruction gives that metaphor a concrete distinction between visibility and successful passage.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The repeated wording and role change are supplied. The concrete analogy uses the packet's road-blocking reading of 29:29; a broader interpretation of that earlier way remains possible.
context_deltas.containment: Do not turn the focus into literal highway obstruction or identify Lot's people with ʿĀd and Thamūd.

context_deltas.reading: The opening names belong to the sequence of peoples seized for wrongdoing; their punitive downfall is what their dwellings make apparent.

focus_anchor.role: The coordinated accusatives invite completion from the surrounding catalogue.

structural_cues.role: The immediately preceding case moves from rejection to punitive seizure.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ
structural_cues.role: Adds two named peoples with an elliptical account of their evident condition.
Continues the coordinated naming pattern.
The comprehensive summary identifies seizure for wrongdoing as the shared outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Narrative continuation and the subsequent comprehensive statement resolve the content of the focus's ellipsis without requiring an invented lexical branch.

changed_reading.before: The focus recalls an unspecified condition evident from their dwellings.
changed_reading.after: The condition is their downfall within the sequence of communities and figures punished for wrongdoing.

context_deltas.reader_inference: No additional historical assumption is needed to include the named peoples in the summary. The exact omitted governing expression could still be an instruction to recall them or a statement of destroying them.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim recovery of the exact omitted words or distribute the punishments listed in 29:40 among particular names without further evidence.

context_deltas.reading: The ordinary discernment reading is strengthened toward informed refusal: evidence can be available or recognized while pride and denial prevent submission to it.

focus_anchor.role: The positive cognitive predicate can aggravate responsibility rather than excuse their direction.

activation_trace.role: Real inner discernment is the focal possibility being strengthened.
Clear proofs establish that opposition need not arise from absent evidence.
Self-exaltation and refusal of truth supply a response other than simple ignorance.
The supplied knowing-denial scope makes recognition without acknowledgment an explicit lexical possibility in the window.

structural_cues.role: Maintains the tension between diversion and awareness.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ
structural_cues.role: Immediately pairs the arrival of clear evidence with pride.
Treats rejection of signs as wrongdoing, supporting a non-innocent epistemic failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent evidence-to-pride sequence and later knowing-denial vocabulary resist reducing the focus's discernment to sheer stupidity or fictitious sight.

changed_reading.before: Discernment coexists with diversion, but the kind of failure is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: Informed refusal becomes a stronger reading: recognition can remain present while conduct rejects its implications.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The context supplies the epistemic patterns. Their application to the focus is comparison across distinct groups, not an assertion that Moses addressed ʿĀd or Thamūd. Bounded knowledge and subjective assurance remain live alternatives.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer that every individual consciously recognized the wrongness of every deed or that the focus specifies a complete body of religious knowledge.

context_deltas.reading: Satan's agency does not remove the peoples' responsibility: the attractive deeds remain their own, and their downfall is attributed to their wrongdoing.

focus_anchor.role: Places their ownership of the deeds beside Satan's action upon them.

activation_trace.role: Intentional conduct supports agency belonging to the actors.
Culpable action and adverse consequence ground the summary's attribution of responsibility.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
structural_cues.role: Names the deceiving agent while retaining the possessive their deeds.
Assigns each case its own culpable basis.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
structural_cues.role: Explicitly attributes the wrong to their action upon themselves, not injustice by God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The comprehensive summary constrains the causal explanation: deception and culpable action coexist rather than transferring responsibility entirely to the deceiver.

changed_reading.before: Satan is the explicit agent of diversion; responsibility is not separately explained.
changed_reading.after: The same narrative cases are accountable for their own deeds even under satanic beautification.

context_deltas.reader_inference: No additional causal assumption is needed for the coexistence of these attributions. The packet does not supply a complete theory of freedom or compulsion.
context_deltas.containment: State joint explanatory roles without making the verse settle a broader philosophical account of agency.

context_deltas.reading: Their dwellings become a material counterpart to failed protection: possessing a habitation does not secure its occupants, just as adopted protectors are compared to a weak house.

focus_anchor.role: The habitations provide the material point of contact with the following house-parable.

activation_trace.role: Actual dwelling is retained as the focal image.
The shelter scope, expressly including the spider's house, connects habitation with protective expectation.
Weakness exposes the inadequacy of what is treated as support.

structural_cues.role: Habitations disclose the inhabitants' outcome rather than guarantee their safety.

structural_cues.quote_ar: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ كَمَثَلِ ٱلْعَنكَبُوتِ ٱتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًۭا
structural_cues.role: Explicitly transfers a house-image to reliance on other protectors.
Makes failed protective strength the comparison's evaluative point.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narrative's inhabited places lead into a shelter-parable, allowing the focus's dwellings to signify the difference between having a home and possessing reliable protection.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are evidence of an earlier people's fate.
changed_reading.after: They also embody the failure of apparent security, preparing the following comparison of misplaced reliance to a weak house.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The habitation vocabulary and explicit protector-to-house comparison are supplied. Applying the comparison retrospectively to the focus is a local rhetorical inference.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim that their buildings were structurally flimsy, that all houses are condemned, or that they explicitly worshipped Satan.

context_deltas.reading: The fault is not restraint itself but its direction: Satan restrains people from the way, whereas prayer restrains from indecency and wrongdoing.

focus_anchor.role: Defines the harmful direction of prevention.

activation_trace.role: Transitive restraint supplies the focal action.
Forbidding or restraining supplies the positive counterpart.

structural_cues.role: An agent prevents movement toward the good course.

structural_cues.quote_ar: إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ
structural_cues.role: A parallel restraint-plus-عَنِ construction instead names wrong conduct as what is avoided.

context_deltas.mechanism: Similar directional grammar supports an ethical reversal: the object from which one is restrained determines whether restraint misguides or corrects.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts a harmful act of prevention.
changed_reading.after: Its harmful prevention has a practical opposite in worship that checks precisely the conduct satanic beautification would make acceptable.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The opposed constructions and objects are supplied; identifying them as counterparts requires no added historical story.
context_deltas.containment: Do not claim that this prayer instruction was explicitly given to the named peoples or derive a mechanical account of every worshipper's behavior.

context_deltas.reading: The focus's dwellings and deeds acquire a contrasting outcome: actual righteous work is promised lasting habitation, unlike conduct merely made attractive.

focus_anchor.role: Provides the dwelling side of a comparison joining conduct and habitation.

activation_trace.role: The focus concerns places of habitation.
Repeated work vocabulary connects the focus's deeds with explicitly righteous action and its workers.
Preparing and enabling lodging supplies the positively promised residence.
Enduring residence supplies the contrast in outcome.

structural_cues.role: Dwelling-derived evidence looks back upon the earlier actors.
Their deeds receive only the deceiver's attractive presentation.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًۭا
structural_cues.role: Explicitly joins faith and righteous work to promised lodging.
Specifies continuing occupancy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated conjunction of deeds and dwellings distinguishes attractive evaluation from divinely approved conduct and its lasting result.

changed_reading.before: Deeds and dwellings occur together within a negative historical case.
changed_reading.after: They form one side of a contrast with righteous work rewarded by enduring residence; habitation itself is not the target of condemnation.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The repeated work vocabulary and dwelling promise are supplied. Their pairing across the ayat is a rhetorical inference, not evidence that أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ specifically means building projects.
context_deltas.containment: Do not turn the contrast into an architectural comparison or claim their houses were the particular deeds Satan adorned.

context_deltas.reading: A distinct alternative is real but bounded understanding: they could recognize something correctly without reasoning through, or acting upon, its wider implications.

focus_anchor.role: Its unstated cognitive object leaves the extent of their understanding open.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge of a thing need not specify comprehensive insight into everything relevant.
Turning away from proper direction parallels the focus's diversion despite a correct acknowledgment.
Reasoning and discernment are denied despite the immediately preceding acknowledgment.

structural_cues.role: Allows actual cognition and misdirection to coexist.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: Places a correct acknowledgment of God's action beside being turned away.

structural_cues.quote_ar: لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
structural_cues.role: Again juxtaposes acknowledgment with a failure of reasoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context distinguishes recognizing a fact from integrating its implications. This offers a third account of the focus's tension, distinct from both comprehensive knowing refusal and merely subjective assurance.

changed_reading.before: The last clause might suggest either full recognition resisted or confidence without correctness.
changed_reading.after: It may instead name genuine but limited understanding that does not become effective orientation.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The context supplies acknowledgment alongside misdirection and non-reasoning. Limiting the scope of the focus's discernment in the same way is reader inference; its actual object is not identified.
context_deltas.containment: Do not assign these particular answers or a specific worldly expertise to ʿĀd and Thamūd.

context_deltas.reading: The lost way has a positive counterpart in God's promised guidance toward His ways: discernment must be joined to committed striving and doing good, not merely attractive self-appraisal.

focus_anchor.role: Supplies the negative direction reversed by the closing guidance promise.

activation_trace.role: The way is a course from which the people are diverted.
Guidance toward a way or truth supplies the opposing directional action.
The repeated root now names God's ways as the destination of guidance.
Doing good provides an enacted counterpart to conduct merely presented as attractive.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
structural_cues.role: Satanic presentation results in movement away from the way.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
structural_cues.role: Striving is answered by promised guidance and divine company with those doing good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated way-language, opposed agents, and opposite directions make the focus's failure one side of a contrast rather than a claim that misdirection is unavoidable.

changed_reading.before: The way appears chiefly as what satanic beautification makes people lose.
changed_reading.after: It belongs to an opposed possibility of divinely guided practice, contrasting genuine good action with attractive presentation.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The guidance promise and directional reversal are supplied. Reading them as a counterpart to the focus requires no invented historical episode.
context_deltas.containment: Do not derive a numerical doctrine from singular way versus plural ways or detach the guidance promise from its stated divine agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The dwellings can carry a darker stillness-image: places of settled life now point toward lives brought to a halt.

focus_anchor.role: The dwelling noun provides access to the root's stillness image.

activation_trace.role: Violent shaking supplies the preceding motion.
Clinging low and remaining in place supplies its immobilized result.
Cessation of movement lends a secondary image to the ordinary dwelling noun.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دَارِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
structural_cues.role: Moves from shaking to people motionless in their habitation.
The next habitation reference can inherit that changed affective value.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: Immediate sequence activates a reversal within settling: ordinary residential rest is shaded by the terminal immobilization of the preceding inhabitants.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are ordinary places of settlement supplying evidence.
changed_reading.after: Their settlement-image can also evoke the cessation of the lives once active there.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaking, immobilized inhabitants, and the stillness branch. Carrying this bodily stillness into the next dwelling noun is a reader-made resonance across different peoples.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprise is the shift from habitation to terminal rest, anchored by the immediately preceding domestic scene. It does not make مَسَاكِن mean corpses or assign the same earthquake or bodily posture to ʿĀd and Thamūd.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The blocked way and continuing discernment can acquire a web-like optical counter-image: misleading appearance intervenes in seeing, just as the later spider-house exposes misleading reliance.

focus_anchor.role: The immediate conjunction of way-obstruction and discernment anchors the optical resonance.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary way-image remains the grammatical reading.
The specifically eye-disease scope supplies a web-like film, not a generic curtain.
Inner sight provides the cognitive domain to which the optical image can be compared.
The thin web-weaving creature activates the unusually precise spider-web component of the eye-film branch.

structural_cues.role: Places obstructed direction immediately beside a positive seeing predicate.
Introduces the spider-image in the closely following comparison.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The later spider activates a branch under the focal way-root whose scope explicitly joins webbing and impaired sight. This supplies an optional image of mediation between perceptive people and sound direction.

changed_reading.before: The way is obstructed while the people retain discernment.
changed_reading.after: That tension can additionally be pictured through web-like interference with seeing, linking deceptive evaluation to the following image of deceptive protection.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The web-like eye-film branch, spider occurrence, and sight/path adjacency are supplied. Their connection is reader-made and does not establish that the differently formed disease noun is the meaning of ٱلسَّبِيلِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses route, eye pathology, and spider imagery, yet each link has a specific anchor. Preserve it only as exploratory resonance, never as a translation, diagnosis, or assertion that their eyes literally became diseased.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The deeds once made attractive acquire an experiential counter-image: what seemed good must be encountered through its consequences, expressed later as tasting what one did.

focus_anchor.role: Makes deeds the object of an attractive presentation that can be contrasted with later experience.

activation_trace.role: Presented beauty supplies the initial evaluative appearance.
The sensory sight branch supports an optical echo alongside the ordinary discernment reading.
Experiencing hardship or punishment supplies tasting as direct undergoing.
Repeated intentional-work vocabulary connects attractive deeds with experienced consequences.

structural_cues.role: The deeds are initially approached through beautified evaluation.
Adds seeing-language to the evaluative setting.

structural_cues.quote_ar: يَوْمَ يَغْشَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
structural_cues.role: Joins punishment to tasting what was done, overturning a merely attractive appraisal.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The recurrence of work under different perceptual relations permits a cross-sensory reversal: presented attractiveness gives way to unavoidable experience.

changed_reading.before: The focus emphasizes how their deeds appeared attractive to them.
changed_reading.after: That attractiveness can be read against the later requirement to undergo the consequences of deeds rather than trust their presentation.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies beautification, seeing-language, tasting, and repeated work vocabulary. A visual-to-experiential reversal is reader inference; beautification can also occur through speech, and the later audience is not explicitly these two peoples.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising sensory transfer is anchored in shared deeds-language. Do not literalize deeds as food, invent a flavor, or present 29:55 as a quotation addressed specifically to ʿĀd and Thamūd.

summary.ordinary_reading: ʿĀd and Thamūd were among those punished for wrongdoing, their fate apparent from their dwellings. Satan made their deeds attractive and diverted them from the right way despite their discernment; his agency does not cancel their responsibility.
coexisting_readings: The dwellings are material warning signs for later reasoners and a counterpart to the following image of failed protection.
Genuine insight resisted in practice is strengthened by context. Real but bounded understanding and subjective assurance remain distinct, qualified alternatives.
False promises of transferred liability and the rewards of belonging offer separate exploratory social mechanisms for attractive misdirection.
Blocked passage distinguishes seeing a way from following it. Prayer's restraint from wrong and God's guidance toward His ways supply positive directional counterparts.
The dwelling-and-work contrast also admits lasting habitation promised for genuinely righteous conduct.
Exploratory resonances include settlement as terminal stillness, a spider-web-like interference with seeing, and attractive deeds re-encountered through their consequences.
unresolved_limits: The exact omitted governing expression, the details visible in the dwellings, and the distribution of particular punishments remain unspecified.
The object and extent of مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ are unstated. The concessive reading is natural, but the wording does not explicitly say although or in their own estimation.
Comparisons across different peoples and audiences do not establish the named peoples' specific social motives, expertise, or prophetic encounters.
The outliers are contained lexical-image resonances, not alternative translations or historical and medical claims.

All listed focus roots have mapped inventories, but Thamūd has no supplied rooted occurrence. The unmapped context roots ك ي ف, ع ث و, and خ ط ط, and the absence of rooted QAC rows for 29:1, are source gaps rather than proof of lexical absence; text-backed evidence remains available.
